title.rendered: Sound Crush Mini Trig eco friendly Bluetooth Speaker With RGB light

content.rendered:
Features

Compact Yet Powerful: : Despite its small size, the Sound Crush Mini Trig Bluetooth Speaker delivers a room-filling sound bass performance, thanks to its 3W super output and BASS technology. Enjoy smooth beats and vibrant music wherever you go.
TWS Enabled: Take your audio experience to the next level with True Wireless Stereo (TWS) capability. Pair two Mini Trig speakers for an immersive stereo sound experience that will elevate your listening pleasure.
Long-lasting Battery Life: With a rechargeable 1200mAh battery, the Mini Trig ensures up to 8 hours of continuous playtime on a single 2-hour charge. Say goodbye to interruptions and keep the music going all day long
Stylish and Convenient Design: Featuring a sleek leather handle for easy portability, the Mini Trig is as stylish as it is functional. Its handheld design allows you to take your music anywhere, while the dimmer function lets you adjust the solo light to suit your mood.
Cutting-edge Connectivity: Equipped with Bluetooth 5.3 technology, the Mini Trig Speaker ensures seamless wireless connectivity with your devices. Plus, the Type-C charging port offers fast and efficient charging, so you can spend less time waiting and more time enjoying your favorite tunes.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.

Physical Unit

  • Mini Trig speaker
  • Type-C charge cable
  • Manual
  • Carry rope
  • Size 130x130x150mm.
